Resolutions of 2011

66 resolutions, 94% unanimous. From Libya to Syria.

  • 1967 (2011) Authorization of the deployment of additional military personnel and capacities to the UN Operation in Côte d'Ivoire (UNOCI) until 30 June 2011
  • 1968 (2011) Extension up to 3 months of the temporary redeployment of infantry companies and an aviation unit from the UN Mission in Liberia (UNMIL) to the UN Operation in Côte d'Ivoire (UNOCI)
  • 1969 (2011) Extension of the mandate of the UN Integrated Mission in Timor-Leste (UNMIT) until 26 Feb. 2012
  • 1970 (2011) Establishment of a Security Council Committee to monitor implementation of the arms embargo against the Libyan Arab Jamahiriya
  • 1971 (2011) Withdrawal of military personnel providing security for the Special Court for Sierra Leone by the UN Mission in Liberia (UNMIL)
  • 1972 (2011) Arms embargo against Somalia and provision of humanitarian assistance
  • 1973 (2011) Establishment of a ban on flights in the Libyan Arab Jamahiriya airspace
  • 1974 (2011) Extension of the mandate of the UN Assistance Mission in Afghanistan (UNAMA) until 23 Mar. 2012
  • 1975 (2011) Targeted sanctions against individuals meeting the criteria set out in resolution 1572 (2004) on arms embargo against Côte d'Ivoire
  • 1976 (2011) Acts of piracy and armed robbery at sea off the coast of Somalia
  • 1977 (2011) Non-proliferation of weapons of mass destruction and extension of the mandate of the Security Council Committee Established pursuant to Resolution 1540 (2004) concerning Non-Proliferation of Nuclear, Chemical and Biological Weapons until 25 Apr. 2021
  • 1978 (2011) Extension of the mandate of the UN Mission in Sudan (UNMIS) until 9 July 2011 and on preparations for the establishment of a successor mission
  • 1979 (2011) Extension of the mandate of the UN Mission for the Referendum in Western Sahara (MINURSO) until 30 Apr. 2012
  • 1980 (2011) Renewal of measures imposed by Security Council resolutions 1572 (2004), 1643 (2005), 1946 (2010) and 1975 (2011) on sanctions against Côte d'Ivoire and extension of the mandate of the UN Group of Experts until 30 Apr. 2012
  • 1981 (2011) Renewal of the mandate of the UN Operation in Côte d'Ivoire (UNOCI) until 31 July 2011
  • 1982 (2011) Renewal of the mandate of the UN Panel of Experts Established pursuant to Resolution 1591 (2005) on the Sudan until 19 Feb. 2012
  • 1983 (2011) Impacts of HIV/AIDS epidemic in conflict and post-conflict situations
  • 1984 (2011) Extension of the mandate of the Panel of Experts Established pursuant to Resolution 1929 (2010) concerning the Islamic Republic of Iran until 9 June 2012
  • 1985 (2011) Renewal of the mandate of the UN Panel of Experts Established pursuant to Security Council Resolution 1874 (2009) concerning the Democratic People's Republic of Korea until 12 June 2012
  • 1986 (2011) Extension of the mandate of the UN Peacekeeping Force in Cyprus (UNFICYP) until 15 Dec. 2011
  • 1987 (2011) Recommendation that Ban Ki-moon be appointed Secretary-General of the UN for a second term of office from 1 Jan. 2012 to 31 Dec. 2016
  • 1988 (2011) Establishment of a new Sanctions Committee concerning Individuals and Entities and Other Groups and Undertakings associated with the Taliban
  • 1989 (2011) Extension of the mandate of the Office of the Ombudsperson and the establishment of a new Al-Qaida sanctions list
  • 1990 (2011) Establishment of the UN Interim Security Force for Abyei (UNISFA)
  • 1991 (2011) Extension of the mandate of the UN Organization Stabilization Mission in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (MONUSCO) until 30 June 2012
  • 1992 (2011) Redeployment of logistics and military personnel from the UN Mission in Liberia (UNMIL) to the UN Operation in Côte d'Ivoire (UNOCI)
  • 1993 (2011) Extension of the terms of office of permanent and ad litem judges at the International Criminal Tribunal for the Former Yugoslavia (ICTY)
  • 1994 (2011) Renewal of the mandate of the UN Disengagement Observer Force (UNDOF) until 31 Dec. 2011
  • 1995 (2011) Ad litem judges and elections for the presidency of the International Criminal Tribunal for Rwanda (ICTR)
  • 1996 (2011) Establishment of the UN Mission in South Sudan (UNMISS)
  • 1997 (2011) Withdrawal of the UN Mission in Sudan (UNMIS)
  • 1998 (2011) Children and armed conflict
  • 1999 (2011) Admission of the Republic of South Sudan to membership in the United Nations
  • 2000 (2011) Renewal of the mandate of the UN Operation in Côte d'Ivoire (UNOCI) until 31 July 2012
  • 2001 (2011) Extension of the mandate of the UN Assistance Mission for Iraq (UNAMI) for a period of 12 months
  • 2002 (2011) Re-establishment of the UN Monitoring Group Established pursuant to Security Council Resolution 1519 (2003) on arms embargo against Somalia for a period of 12 months
  • 2003 (2011) Extension of the mandate of the AU/UN Hybrid Operation in Darfur (UNAMID) until 31 July 2012
  • 2004 (2011) Extension of the mandate of the UN Interim Force in Lebanon (UNIFIL) until 31 Aug. 2012
  • 2005 (2011) Extension of the mandate of the UN Integrated Peacebuilding Office in Sierra Leone (UNIPSIL) until 15 Sept. 2012
  • 2006 (2011) Reappointment of Hassan Bubacar Jallow as Prosecutor of the International Criminal Tribunal for Rwanda (ICTR) for a term with effect from 15 Sept. 2011 until 31 Dec. 2014
  • 2007 (2011) Reappointment of the Prosecutor of the International Tribunal for the Former Yugoslavia (ICTY) for a term with effect from 1 Jan. 2012 until 31 Dec. 2014
  • 2008 (2011) Extension of the mandate of the UN Mission in Liberia (UNMIL) until 30 Sept. 2012
  • 2009 (2011) Establishment of the UN Support Mission in Libya (UNSMIL)
  • 2010 (2011) Renewal of the authorization to Member States of the African Union to maintain the deployment until 31 Oct. 2012 of the African Union Mission in Somalia (AMISOM) and extension of the logistical support package for AMISOM
  • 2011 (2011) Extension of the authorization of the International Security Assistance Force in Afghanistan (ISAF) until 13 Oct. 2012
  • 2012 (2011) Extension of the mandate of the UN Stabilization Mission in Haiti (MINUSTAH) until 15 Oct. 2012
  • 2013 (2011) Decision for Judge Bakhtiyar Tuzmukhamedov to work part-time at the International Criminal Tribunal for Rwanda (ICTR)
  • 2014 (2011) The situation in Yemen
  • 2015 (2011) Acts of piracy and armed robbery at sea off the coast of Somalia
  • 2016 (2011) Termination of the provisions of paras. 4, 5 and 6 to 12 of Security Council resolution 1973 (2011) concerning Libya
  • 2017 (2011) Measures to prevent the proliferation of all arms and related materiel of all types in Libya
  • 2018 (2011) Acts of piracy and armed robbery at sea off the coast of the States of the Gulf of Guinea
  • 2019 (2011) Authorization to establish a multinational stabilization force (EUFOR) in Bosnia and Herzegovina as a legal successor to stabilization force (SFOR) for a period of 12 months
  • 2020 (2011) Acts of piracy and armed robbery against vessels in the waters off the coast of Somalia
  • 2021 (2011) Renewal of measures on arms, transport, finance and travel against the Democratic Republic of the Congo imposed by Security Council resolution 1807 (2008) and extension of the mandate of the Group of Experts Established pursuant to Resolution 1533 (2004) until 30 Nov. 2012
  • 2022 (2011) Extension of the mandate of the UN Support Mission in Libya (UNSMIL) until 16 Mar. 2012
  • 2023 (2011) Measures against Eritrea and expansion of the mandate of the Monitoring Group re-established by Security Council resolution 2002 (2011)
  • 2024 (2011) Expansion of the mandate of the UN Interim Security Force for Abyei (UNISFA)
  • 2025 (2011) Renewal of measures on arms and travel imposed by resolution 1521 (2003) and extension of the mandate of the Panel of Experts appointed pursuant to para. 9 of Security Council resolution 1903 (2009) concerning Liberia for a period of 12 months
  • 2026 (2011) Extension of the mandate of the UN Peacekeeping Force in Cyprus (UNFICYP) until 19 July 2012
  • 2027 (2011) Extension of the mandate of the UN Office in Burundi (BNUB) until 15 Feb. 2013
  • 2028 (2011) Renewal of the mandate of the UN Disengagement Observer Force (UNDOF) until 30 June 2012
  • 2029 (2011) Extension of the terms of office of permanent and ad litem judges to the International Criminal Tribunal for Rwanda (ICTR) until 30 June 2012
  • 2030 (2011) Extension of the mandate of the UN Integrated Peacebuilding Office in Guinea-Bissau (UNIOGBIS) until 28 Feb. 2013
  • 2031 (2011) Extension of the mandate of the UN Integrated Peacebuilding Office in the Central African Republic (BINUCA) until 31 Jan. 2013
  • 2032 (2011) Extension of the mandate of the UN Interim Security Force for Abyei (UNISFA) for a period of 5 months
